question: Question linked to the image nº10 Indicate in which type of De Bakey classification the pathology shown in the image could be included:

options.opd: In order to classify it, the area of ​​reentry distal to the light of the aorta must be appreciated, which is not visualized in the image.

analysis: Without viewing the image, the classification depends on the location of the dissection. If the dissection involves the ascending aorta, it could be Type I or Type II. If it involves the descending aorta, it would be Type III. If the image does not show the distal reentry point, classification might be challenging.
